title: 第9章 两宗皆灭空间大道第10章 天元大比成仙机缘
slug: 开局亿年修为弹指间秒杀一切
content_zh:
“唉，还真够惨的。”
“你要是死了，小梦儿肯定会伤心的。”
“罢了，虽然你这个宗主做的确实不怎么样，但飞仙宗还得靠你管理呢。”
“散！”
随着李如风的开口，原本就要触碰到他的攻击瞬间凭空消散。
这一幕，顿时把顾狂生等人给惊呆在原地。
“这怎么可能？！”
“仅仅是一个字，就化解了我的攻击，这不可能！”
数息过后，顾狂生在心中疯狂大叫道。
此刻，不仅是顾狂生，其余人心中或多或少都开始有些质疑刚才那一幕的真实性。
尤其是南宫烈，他受到的震撼是最大的。
“李如风！”
“你肯定是使用了最后那一个底牌，对一定是这样！”
“你不要以为这样，就能吓住我们！”
“二位宗主，他就是我说的李如风，他修为早就废了。”
“刚才为了抵挡那道攻击使用了他最后一张底牌。”
“现在他，对我们已经毫无威胁了。”
“你们不要被他的刚才的手段给吓住。”
南宫烈越说，越觉得他说的都是真的。
殊不知，下方的李如风正在淡淡看着犹如跳梁小丑一般的南宫烈。

“呵呵，说得好。”
“遗言说完了，那就上路吧。”
李如风呵呵一笑，随即身上爆发出一股强大的气息直朝高空中的南宫烈等人而去。
几乎是眨眼之间，南宫烈等人全都消失不见，只留下了一团团血雾。
随着身体被炸成血雾，南宫烈等人的灵魂缓缓显露出来。
为了留下他们的灵魂，李如风刚才还特意只用了一丝丝力量。
下一刻，李如风手中便多了一件物品，上面还散发出丝丝诡异的黑气。
“收！”
随着李如风的开口，南宫烈等人的灵魂便被其手中的东西全部吸收进去。
“不错不错，我这人皇幡的力量，又增强了一点。”
“接下来，到你了。”
李如风自言自语着，随后突然朝着一个方向一眼瞪去。
“砰！”
转瞬之间，空中凭空多了一团血雾。
这道血雾，便是顾狂生他们请来的那名化神境强者。
但悲催的是，他连面都没有露，就直接被李如风秒杀，灵魂也被其收进“人皇幡”中。
解决完这一切后，李如风再次低头望向趴在地上的，气息时刻都要消散的沈星河。
content_en:
"Oh, it's really miserable."
"If you die, Xiao Meng'er will definitely be sad."
"That's all. Although you, the sect leader, are indeed not doing very well, Feixian Sect still needs to be managed by you."
"Disperse!"
As Li Rufeng spoke, the attack that was about to touch him instantly dissipated out of thin air.
This scene immediately stunned Gu Kuangsheng and others.
"How is this possible?!"
"Just one word can neutralize my attack. This is impossible!"
After a few breaths, Gu Kuangsheng yelled crazily in his heart.
At this moment, not only Gu Kuangsheng, but also everyone else began to doubt the authenticity of the scene just now.
Especially Nangong Lie, he was the most shocked.
"Li Rufeng!"
"You must have used the last trump card, that's right!"
"Don't think that you can scare us!"
"Two sect masters, he is the Li Rufeng I mentioned. His cultivation has been ruined long ago."
"Just now he used his last trump card to resist the attack."
"He is no longer a threat to us now."
"Don't be intimidated by what he just did."
The more Nangong Lie said, the more he felt that what he said was true.
As everyone knows, Li Rufeng below is looking at Nangong Lie indifferently like a clown.
"Haha, well said."
"Now that I have said my last words, let's get on the road."
Li Rufeng chuckled, and then a powerful aura erupted from his body and headed straight towards Nangong Lie and others high in the sky.
Almost in the blink of an eye, Nangong Lie and others all disappeared, leaving only clouds of blood mist.
As the bodies were blown into blood mist, the souls of Nangong Lie and others slowly emerged.
In order to keep their souls, Li Rufeng deliberately used only a trace of power just now.
The next moment, Li Rufeng had an item in his hand, and there was a strange black air emitting from it.
"Take it!"
As Li Rufeng spoke, the souls of Nangong Lie and others were absorbed by the things in his hands.
"Not bad, not bad. The power of my Human Emperor Banner has increased a little."
"Next, it's your turn."
Li Rufeng muttered to himself, then suddenly glared in one direction.
"Bang!"
In an instant, a cloud of blood mist appeared in the sky.
This blood mist is the powerful man in the God Transformation Realm invited by Gu Kuangsheng and the others.
But the tragedy is that he was instantly killed by Li Rufeng without even showing his face, and his soul was also collected into the "Human Emperor Banner" by him.
After settling all this, Li Rufeng lowered his head again and looked at Shen Xinghe who was lying on the ground, his aura threatening to dissipate at any moment.
